subject: Deployment on a commercial web hosting service

messages.author: 6231b08a9aedcf52
messages.subject: Deployment on a commercial web hosting service
parts:
Hi,
I am very interested in creating Shiny web applications. However, I don't understand how R is to be installed on my server. 

I don't run my own server, but buy web hosting space from Lunarpages, which uses cPanel as a backend.

Will I be able to install Shiny in such a setting, or do I need to have a dedicated server to pull that off?

Thank you for your support.

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Deployment on a commercial web hosting service
parts:
No, it's not possible to run Shiny on a commercial (shared) web hosting service right now (and extremely unlikely that you could even run R at all). You can however sign up for our Shiny hosting beta program by going to http://rstudio.com/shiny and clicking the registration link near the bottom of the page. We'll come out with our Shiny Server standalone software in the relatively near future and then you could host Shiny on an Amazon EC2 server, or a Virtual Private Server at a commercial web host (but still not shared web hosting which is what all the really inexpensive plans are).

Web deployment for Shiny apps is still evolving, please be patient as we really want to do a great job of it! Thanks!
